Strategy: Split items into three size classes with a different rule each: small items aim at leftover [20,35], medium at [28,42], large items take the loosest bin.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if item < 30 and 20 <= r - item <= 35 else 0) + (20 if item >= 30 and item < 60 and 28 <= r - item <= 42 else 0) + (40 if item >= 60 and r == max(bins) else 0) for r in bins]
```
